description:
Configure an automated surveillance alert in DHIS2 for the National Surveillance Unit. Detailed requirements:

1. Create a User Group named 'Emergency Response Team' and add your current user (admin) to it.
2. Create a Validation Rule named 'Measles Outbreak Threshold'. This rule should flag a violation when Measles cases are greater than 5 (i.e., the rule defines valid data as Measles <= 5). Use the 'Measles' data element (or 'Measles / suspected') on the left side and the number 5 on the right side.
3. Create a Validation Rule Group named 'Epidemic Alerts' and add your new rule to it.
4. Create a Validation Notification named 'Measles Alert SMS'. Configure it to trigger when a validation result is generated for the 'Epidemic Alerts' group, sending a notification to the 'Emergency Response Team' user group. The message subject/template should mention 'Measles'.

You will need to use the Maintenance app to configure these metadata objects.
